messages:
Tara (Design): quick check 12 — proposing a 'matrix' preview for thresholds across prod/staging/dev. shows channel recipients per environment. mock: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/threshold-matrix.png
Ben (PM): nice. main ask: make it obvious when a recipient is suppressed in one env but active in another. people miss cross-env differences.
Hugo (Frontend): idea: add a small state chip per cell: Active / Suppressed (reason). cells are keyboard focusable and expand into a details panel. spinner while we fetch resolved endpoints.
Lina (A11y): accessibility: each cell expansion must move focus into the detail panel and announce the state. use clear text not color. prefixed labels like '(Suppressed) Slack #ops' help SR users.
Tara (Design): microcopy: header 'Alert thresholds by environment' and cell action 'View recipients' (not just 'Details'). suppression copy: 'Suppressed 12 maintenance until Jul 2, 14:00 UTC'.
Ben (PM): UX choice: when a routing rule maps alert to multiple endpoints, show up to 2 inline then '+N more recipients' link. link needs tooltip showing mapping rule.
Hugo (Frontend): will implement +N as a button with aria-expanded; expansion lazy-loads full list. sample dev payload:
```
env: "prod"
resolvedRecipients: ["slack:#ops (mapped by: route-A)", "webhook:https://...", "email:alerts+prod@example.com"]
suppression: "maintenance until 2024-07-02T14:00Z"
```
Lina (A11y): ensure tooltip is keyboard-focusable and the expanded list is in an aria-live region. also check contrast for the state chips.
design-bot: design file updated https://figma.redwood.app/file/threshold-matrix/v1 (published).
Tara (Design): decisions: 1) matrix view with per-env cells 2) cells show state chip + 'View recipients' 3) up to 2 recipients inline + '+N more recipients' focusable 4) suppression message inline with reason + end time 5) aria-live announcements and focus management 6) lazy-load recipients. I'll update figma and open tickets.
Ben (PM): please add a short keyboard walkthrough in the ticket for SREs.
Hugo (Frontend): I'll add dev story and example payload.
Lina (A11y): I'll add an a11y checklist and test plan.
Tara (Design): thanks all 12 will close after figma + tickets are linked.
